const CONDITION = new RegExp([
  '\\b(?:if|while|whilst|each time|every time|until|unless|after|when|whenever|once it has|once this (?:unit|model) has)\\b',
  '\\b(?:in|during|at the start of|at the end of) (?:your |the |your opponent\'s |each |either player\'s )?(?:command|movement|shooting|charge|fight) phase\\b',
  '\\bthat targets?\\b', '\\bagainst [A-Z]', '\\bagainst (?:an? |the )?[a-z]+ (?:units?|models?)\\b', '\\bmade a charge move\\b', '\\bwithin \\d+"', '\\bon a turn\\b',
  '\\bfor (?:every|each) \\b', '\\bduring the battle round in which\\b', '\\bselect(?:s|ed)? (?:one|a)\\b'].join('|'), 'i');

source.implements: verify/readings.js: the words that make a bonus conditional (if, while, each time, until, after, when, once it has, in / at the start or end of a phase, that targets, against X units, within N", on a turn, for every / each, during the battle round in which, select one)

verify/readings.js: a weapon ability granted: in brackets (qualified ones too, "[LETHAL HITS: non-MONSTER/VEHICLE]"), "the X ability" in any case, or bare after have / has / gain ("have Sustained Hits 1")
verify/readings.js: a sentence referring back to the one before it ("If it does", "that unit", "those weapons", "Until …"), the only kind an earlier sentence's condition counts for

const DEFENCE = [
  { id:'fnp',      re:/feel no pain \d\+/i, said:/feel no pain|FNP|"fnp"/i },
  { id:'invuln',   re:/\d\+\*? ?(?:invulnerable save|insv)\b/i, said:/invulnerable|InSv|\bINV\b/i },
  { id:'save+1',   re:/\+1 to (?:armou?r )?sav(?:e|ing) (?:rolls?|throws?)|add 1 to (?:the |its )?(?:armou?r )?sav(?:e|ing) (?:rolls?|throws?)/i, said:/\+1 to (?:armou?r )?sav|\bsave\b|"sv"/i },
  { id:'stealth',  re:/\b(?:has|have|gains?) (?:the )?stealth\b/i, said:/stealth|"stealth"|benefit of cover/i },
  { id:'dmg-1',    re:new RegExp('(?:allocated to ' + SELF + '|made against (?:' + SELF + '|this [A-Z]+\\b)|attacks? (?:that )?targets? ' + SELF + '|attacks? allocated to ' + SELF + ')[^.]*?(?:subtract 1 from the damage|-1 d\\b|-1 damage\\b)', 'i'), said:/-1 D\b|-1 Damage|damage/i },
  { id:'dmg-0',    re:/change the damage characteristic of that attack to 0/i, said:/damage[^|]* to 0|"dmg":0/i },
  { id:'hit-vs',   re:new RegExp('(?:an attack|attacks|a ranged attack|a melee attack|ranged attacks|melee attacks)(?: that)? targets? ' + SELF + '[^.]*?(?:subtract 1 from (?:the|that attack[\\u2019\\x27]s) hit roll|-1 to hit)', 'i'), said:/-1 to (?:the )?hit/i },
  // an enemy unit's attacks made worse (Reorder Reality, Mischief Makers): a defence of the units it attacks
  { id:'enemy-hit-1', re:/\benemy (?:unit|model)s?\b[^.]*?(?:subtract 1 from (?:the|that attack[’']s) hit roll|-1 to hit)|(?:subtract 1 from (?:the|that attack[’']s) hit roll|-1 to hit)[^.]*?\benemy (?:unit|model)/i, said:/-1 to (?:the )?hit/i },
  { id:'wound-vs', re:new RegExp('(?:an attack|attacks|a ranged attack|a melee attack|ranged attacks|melee attacks)(?: that)? targets? ' + SELF + '[^.]*?(?:subtract 1 from the wound roll|-1 to wound)', 'i'), said:/-1 to (?:the )?wound/i },
  { id:'ap-worse', re:new RegExp('targets? ' + SELF + '[^.]*?(?:worsen the (?:armou?r penetration|ap)\\b|-1 ap\\b)', 'i'), said:/-1 AP|worsen the AP|\bAP\b/i },
];

source.implements: verify/readings.js: the defences read from the words (Feel No Pain, invulnerable save or InSv, +1 to save rolls, Stealth granted, -1 Damage / -1 D of an attack allocated to or made against the unit, Damage 0, -1 to hit / wound or -1 AP / worse AP against attacks that target it, an enemy unit's -1 to hit; not "this unit's …", "the bearer's …", "an enemy model") and how its "When targeted" reading says each
verify/readings.js: the bonuses to a roll, which need a reading even with no condition (a weapon value cannot show them)
verify/readings.js: a sentence's attack bonuses and defences (ATTACK, DEFENCE, WA_RE after a grant verb); an enemy's or a forbidden re-roll is none; the enemy's -1 to hit is not the unit's own

verify/readings.js: what of a unit reads an ability: its footnotes, auras and guards from it or an option it names in bold, its row's def / calcDef / defCalc, its Rules line's Feel No Pain, a value it gives marked on a weapon or stat

verify/readings.js: per sentence and per bonus, a gap when no reading of the ability says it: riled up needs a riled-up reading; an attack bonus with a condition (its own, or an earlier sentence's it refers back to), or a roll bonus with none, needs one; a defence needs a When targeted reading; na and options for keywords the unit lacks are skipped
verify/readings.js: a bonus said by a reading (its said pattern; a weapon ability by its name)
